publications.title: ESMA specifies requirements to facilitate safe use of post-trade risk reduction services
publications.summary: ESMA specifies requirements to facilitate safe use of post-trade risk reduction services 20 October 2026 Guidelines and Technical standards Post Trading The European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA), the EU’s financial markets regulator and supervisor, has outlined the conditions that providers and users of post-trade risk reduction (PTRR) services need to meet for certain OTC derivative transactions to be exempt from the clearing obligation under EMIR 3. The new rules, published in its latest final report, also establish safeguards for the provision of these services and the monitoring of the use of the exemption. With these new rules in place, the goal is to facilitate the use of PTRR services and ensure that the exemption is used under the conditions laid down in EMIR 3 and does not lead to the misuse of the clearing obligation. publications.title: Bank liquidity regulation and the growth of private credit
publications.summary: We study the role of bank liquidity regulation in the growth of private credit. Following the introduction of the liquidity coverage ratio (LCR), private credit increases significantly more in U.S. counties with a larger footprint of banks subject to the LCR or of LCR banks with greater initial liquidity shortfalls.
